info.title: Firebolt-9 API schema
info.description: OpenRPC document for the RDK Core Specs 'Firebolt 9 Core API Specification' (rdk-core-specs/video/rdk9). Wire format follows JSON-RPC 2.0: method and parameter names are case sensitive, params is always an object (by-name) and is omitted when a method has no parameters; a method with no return value responds with result null. Event methods (on*) take a required listen parameter; their result schema is the notification payload, and x-notification describes the on-the-wire notification params ({"value": x} for primitives, the object itself for objects, an array for lists). Every closed object schema sets additionalProperties:false so undocumented properties fail validation.

methods.name: Lifecycle2.close
methods.summary: Request the platform to deactivate the app, and possibly take further action
methods.description: window.close() maps to unload; window.minimize() maps to deactivate. The module is named Lifecycle in the C++ Client Library.

methods.name: Lifecycle2.state
methods.summary: Returns the current lifecycle state of the app
methods.description: The first lifecycle state that can be observed by an app/runtime is initializing. Apps/runtimes should ordinarily use state change notifications rather than this method.

methods.name: Lifecycle2.onStateChanged
methods.summary: Notifies on lifecycle state changes
methods.description: Raised after the platform has transitioned the app/runtime to the new lifecycle state; the list always carries exactly one change. The app/runtime remains in the initializing state until the subscribe call is made. Valid transitions: initializing->paused, initializing->suspended, paused->active, active->paused, paused->suspended, suspended->paused, suspended->hibernated, hibernated->suspended, any->terminating. Subscribe with params {"listen": true} and unsubscribe with {"listen": false}; the subscription response result is null. The result schema describes the notification payload delivered to the listener. On the wire the notification params is an array that represents one attribute (the payload list), not positional parameters.

params.name: listen
params.summary: true to subscribe to the notification, false to unsubscribe

CountryCode.title: CountryCode

BCP47OrEmpty.title: BCP47OrEmpty
BCP47OrEmpty.description: BCP 47 language tag, or "" if not initialized

AgePolicy.title: AgePolicy
AgePolicy.description: Age group to which content is directed

UtcDateTime.title: UtcDateTime
UtcDateTime.description: ISO 8601 date and time in UTC: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ

IanaTimeZone.title: IanaTimeZone
IanaTimeZone.description: IANA time zone identifier, e.g. America/New_York

FlatMap.title: FlatMap
FlatMap.description: Open map of additional key/value pairs (Firebolt Types.FlatMap). Keys are app defined, so additionalProperties is constrained to primitive values rather than forbidden

JsonDocument.title: JsonDocument
JsonDocument.description: Opaque JSON document whose structure is defined by another specification (e.g. Firebolt Intents). Not closed with additionalProperties:false because its members are not defined by this API

SubscriptionResult.title: SubscriptionResult
SubscriptionResult.description: Result of a successful subscribe ({"listen":true}) or unsubscribe ({"listen":false}) request

ClosedCaptionsSettings.title: ClosedCaptionsSettings
ClosedCaptionsSettings.description: Captions settings: enabled, and zero or more languages in order of decreasing preference

rate.description: 1 is the normal rate; 0.1 to 10 inclusive

ifa_type.description: dpid = device provided ID, sspid = SSP provided ID, sessionid = session/synthetic ID

DeviceClass.title: DeviceClass
DeviceClass.description: ott = no tuner/demod, no integrated display; stb = with tuner/demod, no integrated display; tv = possibly tuner/demod, with integrated display

LifecycleCloseType.title: LifecycleCloseType
LifecycleCloseType.description: deactivate - app is deactivated (if active); unload - app is deactivated (if active) and terminated; killReload - app is killed, then reloaded to paused or suspended (by policy); killReactivate - app is killed, reloaded, then activated

LifecycleStateChange.title: LifecycleStateChange
LifecycleStateChange.description: A single lifecycle state transition. Only the documented valid transitions are accepted

LifecycleStateChangeList.title: LifecycleStateChangeList
LifecycleStateChangeList.description: List that always carries exactly one lifecycle state change

intentId.description: Monotonic: greater than the last intentId

default.description: true if the voice is the default for the language

VoiceList.title: VoiceList
VoiceList.description: Unordered list of zero or more voices. Empty if no speech synthesis engine is available or the engine rejected the request

TTSStatus.title: TTSStatus
TTSStatus.description: 0 OK, 1 Fail, 2 not enabled, 3 invalid configuration. Use TTS_Status, not success, to determine call success

RefreshRate.title: RefreshRate
RefreshRate.description: Refresh rate in Hz (0 if no TV attached). Documented as an enum, which JSON-RPC represents as a string; the numeric form is also accepted (see assumptions)

ColorDepth.title: ColorDepth
ColorDepth.description: Color depth in bits (0 when a display is not connected over HDMI). Documented as an enum, which JSON-RPC represents as a string; the numeric form is also accepted (see assumptions)

params.description: Params is an object. Arrays are not used. Omitted when the method has no parameters. Left open here because the members are method specific and are validated by each method's params content descriptors

result.description: null when there is no return value; a primitive, an array of primitives, or an object

params.description: Object ({"value":x} for primitives, or the object attributes) or an array for list payloads

MethodNotKnown.data: The method is not known to the version of Firebolt on this device

ArgumentsInvalid.data: The set of arguments is not valid

UnspecifiedError.data: Any unexpected error, e.g. memory allocation failure, transport failure
